remarks: MOTIVATED SELLER! Welcome to 218 McKinley, where there is no shortage of character and the impeccable woodwork and craftsmanship shine throughout. Located in the heart of Kenmore Village, this 3-bedroom home offers 2,089 square feet of living space with plenty of room to spread out both inside and out. The freshly painted first floor welcomes you with beautiful hardwood floors and warm natural woodwork that carries throughout the home. A spacious living room opens to the formal dining room, while a separate family room provides even more space to gather and features a distinctive fireplace and access to the heated sunroom overlooking the Trex deck and beautiful backyard gardens. The kitchen is truly one of a kind, featuring custom solid cherry cabinetry handcrafted specifically for this home, featuring architectural decorative glass, pull out spice and pantry cabinets, generous counter space, a professional-style range hood and ultra-quiet stainless steel KitchenAid dishwasher. A convenient half bath completes the first floor. Upstairs you'll find three bedrooms and a full bath with heated floors, plus a bonus room offering the perfect spot for a home office, dressing room, hobby room or other flexible space. An additional half bath can be found in the basement. Outside, this property offers something especially hard to find in the Village. The generously sized lot provides more outdoor space than typically found in the area, along with a double-wide plus parking pad and rare three-car garage. Driveway snow removal is covered by the seller for the winter season. The garage is equipped with 220V power, its own subpanel and newer garage door openers with updated safety features. Full of character, thoughtfully crafted and offering space that’s hard to find in the Village, 218 McKinley is ready to welcome its next owner home.
